Study 1: Ferry a delicate company across without leaving trouble behind.

SAFETY INVARIANT RIVER TRANSPORT

A different way
to think.
Select cargo on the ferry’s current bank, then Sail. Capacity limits how many can ride; empty crossings are allowed.
Pairs listed as incompatible may never share a bank without the ferryman.
Bring everyone to the far bank. Unsafe crossings are refused with an explanation. New compatibility graphs have verified shortest journeys of 7, 9 and 11 crossings; the final ferry carries three. Undo reverses a safe crossing.

Tap buttons or use Tab and Enter / Space. Direction games also support arrow keys. Undo, Reset study and Restart are always available.

No timer. A check explains what still needs attention. Undo and Reset study keep earlier studies; Restart begins all three again.

Specimen Rule
Restart

Learn and synthesize a compact relational classifier

FIELD STUDY
Field model 1/3 · 0/3 prototypes · 3 audits

Compress a labeled collection into a small nearest-neighbor classifier. Select training prototypes; each reference specimen takes the label of its closest selected prototype. Distance = absolute feature-X difference + absolute feature-Y difference (Manhattan distance). If equally near prototypes disagree, the prediction is ambiguous.

Choose exactly 3 of eight prototypes to classify all twelve reference specimens. Every slot is needed; at least two different valid prototype sets exist. Adding one prototype can move several classification boundaries.

Prototype A: (0,3) accept
Prototype B: (5,4) reject
Prototype C: (5,3) accept
Prototype D: (2,0) accept
Prototype E: (5,0) accept
Prototype F: (4,4) reject
Prototype G: (3,4) reject
Prototype H: (6,2) accept
Ref	X	Y	Required	Predicted	Nearest / distance
1	0	0	accept	ambiguous	—
2	1	5	accept	ambiguous	—
3	0	5	accept	ambiguous	—
4	6	4	reject	ambiguous	—
